name: sage-vscode-plugin
description: Independent monorepo for a SageMath VS Code plugin

scripts.package:vsix: npm run check:package-toolchain && npm run build && npm run test:generated-assets && npm run package:rust-binary && npm run test:vsix-contents && node scripts/package-vsix.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:rust && npm run build --workspace @sage-vscode/syntax-pack && npm run build --workspace sage-vscode-extension
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @sage-vscode/syntax-pack && npm run lint --workspace sage-vscode-extension
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @sage-vscode/syntax-pack && npm run test --workspace sage-vscode-extension && npm run test:debug-web && npm run test:python
scripts.test:lsp-protocol: npm run build:rust && node scripts/lsp-navigation-smoke.mjs && node scripts/lsp-shutdown-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:lsp-latency: npm run build:rust:release && node scripts/lsp-latency-smoke.mjs --profile release
scripts.test:extension-host: npm run build:rust && npm run test:extension-host --workspace sage-vscode-extension
scripts.test:ci: cargo test --locked && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:debug-web:sage && npm run test:lsp-protocol && npm run test:generated-assets && npm run package:rust-binary && npm run test:vsix-contents && npm run test:vsix-package && npm run test:cache-maintenance && npm run test:repo-hygiene && npm run test:product-readiness && npm run test:reference-export && npm run test:performance -- --skip-workbench && git diff --check
scripts.test:release: cargo test --locked && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:debug-web:sage && npm run test:lsp-protocol && npm run test:generated-assets && npm run package:rust-binary && npm run test:vsix-contents && npm run test:vsix-package && npm run test:vsix-install && npm run test:cache-maintenance && npm run test:repo-hygiene && npm run test:product-readiness && npm run test:reference-export && npm run test:performance -- --skip-workbench && npm run test:lsp-latency && npm run test:real-file-smoke && git diff --check
scripts.test:full: npm run test:release && npm run test:extension-host
